name: gtm-engineer-tools
description: Claude Code plugins for GTM engineers. Extracted from a working stack, not written as examples.

plugins.name: reply-queue
plugins.description: One pass over every live outbound campaign, ending in a queue of cards — one per person waiting on you, each with the reply already drafted. Mail replies land in your drafts folder on the thread; everything else comes back paste-ready. Drafts everywhere it can, sends nowhere.

plugins.name: automerge
plugins.description: Installs a scheduled workflow that squash-merges any open PR older than 15 minutes with no conflict, no failing check, no hold label and not a draft. For repos where PRs pile up because there is nobody to review them.

plugins.name: deck-graphics
plugins.description: Fill a deck's graphics from a manifest: logos through a Brandfetch → SimpleIcons → favicon chain, on-style props through an image model (OpenRouter or fal.ai) with your own illustrations as references, app-screen mocks through headless Chrome. Every file gets a sidecar saying where it came from. Assets and sidecars only; bring your own deck builder.

plugins.name: always-worktree
plugins.description: Keeps an agent off your default branch. Write and Edit on main are refused with the fix in the message, Bash that looks like a write is refused too, and /always-worktree:main-ok lifts it for four hours when you mean it.

plugins.name: slop-check
plugins.description: Flags AI writing tells in outward-facing prose before it is sent or published. Warns, never blocks. Lives in its own repo with its 382-document human corpus and its attribution chain; listed here so one marketplace covers the set.
